name: Above Eden
source:
Heaven is weakening in the wake of the catastrophe that befell the old world. So the Council has voted: A new Realm is authorized, and construction is to begin. But will every deity play by the rules?

[From [url=https://astralore.itch.io/]Itch.io[/url]]
